title: Titanium Poker/Dab Tool
description:
Titanium Dab Tool
A simple but effective dab or poker tool. Whether you want to launch fat dabs or just stir up your bowl this will do the job.
It has 1 large scoop on one side and a small ball on the other.
﻿
Length
﻿  12 cm
Included
1 X Titanium Dab Tool
